0022600183.text: The Suns (1-3) return home for the 6th game of their season, having lost their last two and sitting 12th in the West, 2.5 games behind for third in the Pacific. The Trail Blazers (4-1) are on a four-game winning run, are 3-0 on the road, and lead the Northwest division. Portland beat Phoenix 124-83 in their 2026-27 meeting in Portland on October 21, though the Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1; Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) is out for Phoenix, while Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) are out for Portland.
